observation.visible_scene: A wide seascape at low sun (sunrise/sunset): the sun sits on the horizon behind a small cloud, casting a golden reflection column on the water; the sky holds thin wispy clouds, and the sea in the foreground shows small breaking waves and foamy wash.
visible_changes: A small dark bird-like speck first appears at the upper-right edge around frame 23 and translates steadily leftward across the sky, descending slightly, through frame 41 (it is absent in the earlier frames).

A wave crest in the mid-foreground steepens and advances toward the camera over the clip: its dark line moves from roughly the middle of the water area downward, and the white foam along its base broadens.
The foreground foam/wash continuously churns and repositions frame to frame as waves roll.
The sun, horizon line, and cloud pattern remain essentially fixed in position throughout the segment.
outside_clip_unknowns: Where the bird came from before frame 23 and where it goes after frame 41.
Whether the advancing wave fully breaks or recedes after the last frame.
Tide and wind conditions before and after this excerpt.
uncertain_details: The moving dark speck is read as a bird but could be an insect or distant object; its identity is not certain.
Background stability suggests little to no intentional camera pan, though minor handheld shake cannot be ruled out.
The exact moment the bird enters is between frame 22 and 23.
